messages.author: 3b926cf200074253
messages.subject: significance of variables
parts:
Good evening,

I would like to ask you if it is possible to quantify in INLA which covariates add significant benefit to the model and estimate contribution from each covariate to the model (say, contribution to variance). Thank you very much in advance.

Best regards,
Ann

messages.author: 3eab71733027a24a
messages.subject: Re: [r-inla] significance of variables
parts:
On Tue, 2016-05-31 at 07:07 -0700, anns...@gmail.com wrote:
> Good evening,
>
> I would like to ask you if it is possible to quantify in INLA which
> covariates add significant benefit to the model and estimate
> contribution from each covariate to the model (say, contribution to
> variance). Thank you very much in advance.

it would be nice to know how much each component contribute to the
variance (of the linear predictor), and this is also one of the central
ideas in https://arxiv.org/abs/1403.4630, where this is used (and will
be used) to define priors that controls the variance contribution from
each component. 

currently, this is not implemented. 

Best,
H

--
Håvard Rue
he...@r-inla.org
